howTo: Page: await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(await figma.getNodeByIdAsync('8253:5009')). Write only inside your section's Content frame (sections.NN.contentId); the Content column is vertical auto-layout, gap 32, width 1024.

Instance: const inst = (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(kit.X)).createInstance(); parent.appendChild(inst); THEN inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = 'FILL' (Canvas, Table row, Cover / Section inside Guide/Frame, Metric card / DoDont / When / Tile inside a horizontal row). For variants use the variant component id directly (e.g. kit.DoDont.Dont, kit.When.Avoid) or inst.setProperties({Kind:'Dont'}).

Text props: inst.setProperties({'Text#24009:2':'Size=lg'}) (Caption), {'Text#24009:3':'…'} (Subheading), {'Label#24009:6':'B'} (Marker), {'Number#24009:7':'3','Label#24009:8':'размера'} (Metric card), {'Rule#24009:14':'…'} (DoDont), {'Title#24069:6':'Badge'} (Cover), {'Number#24069:0':'02','Title#24069:1':'Коротко','Description#24069:2':'…','Show description#24069:3':true} (Section), {'Cell 1#24009:26':'…', …, 'Cell 5#24009:30':'…', 'Marker#24009:31':true} (Table row). No font loading needed for setProperties.

Slots: Canvas/Tile/Section = 'Content', DoDont = 'Example', When = 'Items', Frame = 'Sections', Cover = 'Preview'. const slot = inst.children.find(n => n.type==='SLOT' && n.name==='Content'); slot.appendChild(node). Use direct children, not findOne (finds nested slots); Cover's Preview is nested in 'Container' → inst.findAllWithCriteria({types:['SLOT']}).find(n=>n.name==='Preview'). Slot itemSpacing/padding can be overridden; slot layoutMode can NOT (fixed by the main component: Canvas/Tile/Section/Frame/When = VERTICAL, DoDont Example and Cover Preview = HORIZONTAL) — for the other direction append an auto-layout frame (fills=[], clipsContent=false) into the slot. Text property refs cannot point at slot sublayers (Figma limit).

Guide/Canvas = grey panel (bg/neutral/primary, r24, p48); Guide/Tile = white example tile (r16, p32, centered); Guide/Caption goes ABOVE the example (put Caption + example in a vertical auto-layout cell, gap 12).
Коротко: Canvas → horizontal row frame in slot → 4× Metric card, each layoutSizingHorizontal='FILL'.

Когда использовать (образец 24009:143601, сейчас с примерами): Canvas → horizontal row in slot (fills=[], itemSpacing 24 = Spacing/spacing-6x-xll, counterAxisAlignItems='MIN') → When Use + When Avoid, each FILL. Каждый пункт — строка с живым примером, не голый текст. Через kit: дети слота Items = инстансы Guide/When item; const s = inst.children.find(n=>n.type==='SLOT'&&n.name==='Items'); s.children.forEach((it,i)=>{ it.setProperties({[WhenItem.text]: items[i].text}); const ex = it.children.find(n=>n.type==='SLOT'&&n.name==='Example'); ex.appendChild(items[i].example()); }). Без kit (как в гайде 24009:143313, белая плитка Tile VERTICAL gap 16 = Spacing/spacing-4x-lg): на каждый пункт row = createAutoLayout('HORIZONTAL') (fills=[], gap 24 = Spacing/spacing-6x-xll, counterAxis CENTER, FILL) → cell 'Example' (createAutoLayout HORIZONTAL, resize(160,40), FIXED/HUG, minHeight 40, primary MIN, counter CENTER, fills=[], clip off) + существующий текст Item (FILL, textAutoResize HEIGHT). Примеры — инстансы 1×: Use = Badge 23457:2960 с реальной подписью и цветом (статус «На заполнении» Pale blue + иконка edit, метка меню «Новое» Green sm, статус модалки «Черновик» Gray); у Badge по умолчанию включены обе иконки — выключать '👈 Left icon#8257:0'/'👉 Right icon#8257:3'. Avoid = сам альтернативный компонент (Counter-badge с числом, Dot-badge, Chips). Нет компонента — ячейку оставить пустой и сообщить. Текст ≤ 7 слов; в Avoid 'случай → компонент'; дефис в названии компонента — неразрывный U+2011 (иначе перенос 'Dot-/badge'). Скелеты, рисованные фейки и OLD-компоненты запрещены.

Делаем / не делаем (образец 24009:248079): Canvas (override its slot itemSpacing to 48 = Spacing/spacing-12x — gap between pairs) → per pair a horizontal row (fills=[], gap 24 = Spacing/spacing-6x-xll) → DoDont Do + DoDont Dont, each FILL; put the example into the 'Example' slot (white tile, height 180, HORIZONTAL, centered; for a column of examples append a vertical auto-layout 'Stack' frame, gap 12); Rule ≤ 8 words, shown under the tile. The pair must show a visible difference. No bars or strokes.

В интерфейсе: клонировать из реального макета только нужные элементы (карточки, строки таблицы, шапку), а не весь экран в рамке с clipsContent. Пример (гайд 24009:143313): из экрана WEB-Табель 24021:6795 — карточки table-card 24021:6825 (Октябрь · Склад запчастей · На заполнении) и 24021:6826 (Сентябрь · Колл-центр · На согласовании у HR): stack = createAutoLayout('VERTICAL') (fills=[], clipsContent=false, itemSpacing = зазор между ними в оригинале, тут 16) в ячейке под подписью Caption; const c = src.clone(); stack.appendChild(c); клон из FILL-колонки схлопывается до 400 → c.layoutSizingHorizontal='FIXED'; c.resize(src.width, c.height). 1×, внутри ничего не подменять, исходный экран не трогать.

Table: vertical auto-layout frame (gap 0, fills=[]) → 1× Table row Header=Yes + N× Header=No, each FILL. Hide unused columns: inst.children.find(n=>n.name==='Cell 5').visible=false (do it for header and body rows alike). Narrow first=Yes gives a fixed 48 first column for № / marker (Анатомия, Спецификация). In body rows with 'Marker#24009:31'=true, set marker text via the nested instance: cell1.children.find(n=>n.name==='Marker').setProperties({'Label#24009:6':'A'}) and hide 'Text 1' (visible=false). Cell widths cannot be overridden on instances — other column grid → detachInstance().

Marker: Type=Number (anatomy 1,2,3) / Type=Letter (spec A,B,C). Place ON the element: inside a non-auto-layout stage frame, or inst.layoutPositioning='ABSOLUTE' inside auto-layout, then set x/y so the marker center sits on the element edge/corner.

Dimension (spec redlines): kit.Dimension.Horizontal / .Vertical → inst.layoutPositioning='ABSOLUTE' (if parent is auto-layout), inst.resize(measuredWidth, 24) for Horizontal or inst.resize(24, measuredHeight) for Vertical; x/y so the line runs along the measured edge (line is centered in the 24px band). Letter: inst.children.find(n=>n.name==='Marker').setProperties({'Label#24009:6':'B'}). Color bg/neutral/tertiary, marker stays centered on resize.

Overlay: Kind=Padding (bg/critical/secondary-light) / Kind=Gap (bg/brand/secondary-light), fill paint opacity 30% (token kept). Put over the example: inst.layoutPositioning='ABSOLUTE' (if parent is auto-layout), inst.resize(w,h), x/y = measured area. Do not reassign fills; if you ever rebind the token, set paint opacity back to 0.3 after setBoundVariableForPaint (binding resets it to the token alpha 8%).

Сборка гайда (новый гайд, только из kit): 1) const frame = (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(kit.Frame)).createInstance(); place it on free canvas (x/y). 2) const secs = frame.children.find(n=>n.type==='SLOT'&&n.name==='Sections'). 3) Cover: const c = (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(kit.Cover)).createInstance(); secs.appendChild(c); c.layoutSizingHorizontal='FILL'; c.setProperties({'Title#24069:6':'<Component>'}); Preview slot ← component instances at 1× (no scaling). 4) One Guide/Section per chapter: const s = (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(kit.Section)).createInstance(); secs.appendChild(s); s.layoutSizingHorizontal='FILL'; s.setProperties({'Number#24069:0':'02','Title#24069:1':'Коротко'}); optional description: {'Description#24069:2':'…','Show description#24069:3':true}. 5) Blocks: const content = s.children.find(n=>n.type==='SLOT'&&n.name==='Content'); content.appendChild(Canvas / When / DoDont rows / Table / Caption+Tile …). Gap 160 between sections comes from the Sections slot; for the 96 gap Cover → section 01 wrap both in a vertical auto-layout frame (fills=[], gap 96 = Spacing/spacing-24x) inside Sections and FILL it. Nodes inside the Frame instance get instance-sublayer ids ('I…;…') — keep the handles returned by appendChild or re-find by traversal from the frame. Fallback without Guide/Frame: plain vertical auto-layout frame 1600, padding 96 (Spacing/spacing-24x), gap 160 (нет токена), fill bg/white/white-primary.

Section aside (existing parallel guide frames, not Guide/Section): description text is hidden and empty — to use: load Inter Regular, set characters, visible=true. Skipped section → (await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(sections.NN.frameId)).remove(). Section 01 lives inside the cover wrapper (coverWrapperId) right under the Cover.

Cover preview (existing parallel guide): coverPreviewSlotId is a plain auto-layout frame (HORIZONTAL, gap 16, right-aligned, fixed 600×124) inside the glass 'Container'; append Badge instances at 1× (no scaling); can switch it to HUG if needed. New guides use Guide/Cover (Preview slot, same geometry).

Kit components live in frame 'Guide kit' (kitFrameId), each inside an 'Item · <name>' wrapper (name + key props caption) grouped in 'Group · …' frames (kitGroups); Tile, Metric card, DoDont and When sit on the grey preview panel (kitPreviewPanelId), Guide/Frame on its own grey backdrop. Do not move or edit kit components; instance them.
